name: experience-crud
description: WordPress plugin for managing winery experiences with Gutenberg support.
author: Lucas

scripts.build: wp-scripts build && npm run copy-php && npm run copy-css
scripts.copy-php: mkdir -p dist/src dist/templates && cp src/experience-crud.php dist/ && cp -r src/Core src/Infrastructure src/includes dist/src/ && [ -d src/templates ] && cp -r src/templates/. dist/templates/ || true && [ -d vendor ] && cp -r vendor dist/ || true
scripts.copy-css: find src/blocks \( -name style.css -o -name editor.css \) | while read f; do t=dist/blocks/${f#src/blocks/}; mkdir -p $(dirname $t); cp $f $t; done
